name: Chicago Traffic Tracker - Historical Congestion Estimates by Region - 2013-2018

columns.name: TIME
columns.description: Date and time corresponding to congestion estimate.

columns.name: REGION_ID
columns.description: Unique arbitrary number to represent each region. See http://bit.ly/103beCf for the geographic location of each region.

columns.name: BUS COUNT
columns.description: The number of buses used to estimate traffic.

columns.name: NUMBER OF READS
columns.description: Number of GPS probes received(or used) for estimating the speed for that segment.

columns.name: SPEED
columns.description: Estimated congestion level. Although expressed in miles per hour, this value is more a reflection of the congestion level in the region than it is indicative of the average raw speed vehicles are travelling within the region.
